name: ai-sdlc
description: Peter's AI-SDLC framework: a stack-agnostic artifact-chain engine plus interchangeable stack packs

plugins.name: sdlc-core
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic artifact-chain SDLC: intent.md -> spec.md -> plan.md -> parallel build -> verify, with a tier router that skips ceremony on small changes. Knows no language or framework; consumes stack packs. Implements Anthropic's AI-Native SDLC Playbook.

plugins.name: stack-dotnet
plugins.description: Opinionated .NET/C# stack pack for sdlc-core: net10.0, Aspire, SQL Server, MSTest, coverlet coverage, and scaffold files. Includes an ML.NET variant.
